db:select.doc:name: Obtener empleado
db:select.db:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) INTO CUENTA FROM KACTUS.NM_CONTR H WHERE H.COD_EMPL = V_COD_EMPL;

db:select.doc:name: Seleccionar informacion basica del empleado
db:select.db:sql: SELECT A.COD_EMPL AS CEDULA, A.NOM_EMPL AS NOMBRES, A.APE_EMPL AS APELLIDOS, C.NOM_CARG AS CARGO, A.EEE_MAIL AS CORREO, D.NOM_CCOS AS CENTRO_COSTO, B.COD_FREP AS COD_FREP, E.NOM_NIVE AS VICEPRESIDENCIA, B.CLA_NOMI AS CLASE_DE_NOMINA, B.FEC_INGR AS FECHA_INICIO FROM KACTUS.BI_EMPLE A, KACTUS.NM_CONTR B, KACTUS.BI_CARGO C, KACTUS.GN_CCOST D, KACTUS.GN_NIVEL E WHERE A.COD_EMPR = 1 AND B.COD_EMPR = 1 AND C.COD_EMPR = 1 AND D.COD_EMPR = 1 AND E.COD_EMPR = 1 AND A.COD_EMPL = B.COD_EMPL AND B.COD_CARG = C.COD_CARG AND B.COD_CCOS = D.COD_CCOS AND B.COD_ARBO = E.COD_ARBO AND B.IDE_ARBO = E.IDE_ARBO AND B.COD_NIV2 = E.COD_NIVE AND D.COD_ARBO = 6 AND B.IDE_ARBO = 'BI' AND B.NRO_CONT IN (SELECT MAX(J.NRO_CONT) FROM KACTUS.NM_CONTR J WHERE B.COD_EMPL = J.COD_EMPL) AND ROWNUM = 1 AND A.COD_EMPL = :codEmpl
